title: SaaS dashboard
intendedUserGoal: Scan operational risk, understand priority metrics, and act on the most important queue.

strongFindings.rootCause: Too many similarly weighted cards compete for first attention.
Multiple header actions use similar weight, weakening the intended next step.

rootCauseObservations: Information priority and density should be treated as the main issue, not as many separate card complaints.
mergeGuidance: Merge repeated card density findings into one summary-region observation.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Avoid listing every metric card as a separate issue.
